Hall, I asked him to get musicians together and that's the one we got Tony Parenti, Max Kaminsky, Marshall Brown and Sonny Greer together and we did the concert.

I went down to -- Cliff was very familiar with Fat Cat -- by his being in these clubs, later after Cafe Society closed he was on 52nd Street again, he was at the old Ryan's on 52nd Street for a long time and then he worked at another club downtown, Lou Terrasi's (phonetic spelling), he was always solo piano and when Ryan's, the club, it had to fold because they tore down that area, Cliff opened in the new Ryan's on 54th Street so he was there for a long time.
